fact: The Police Nationale page says the ONI runs the CNIB checking and issuing system, with its own production centre and intermediate data-processing centres.
The article says the ONI will begin mass production of the CIB-AES card from January 2026.

The Office national d'identification (ONI) runs the enrolment of the AES biometric identity card (CIB-AES), opening nine extra sites in Ouagadougou beside its main centre and setting delivery at 48 hours, per an ONI communiqué.
The ONI, the national identification office, runs CIB-AES enrolment and production, with its own production centres in regional capitals.
The new ONI Koudougou antenna produces CNIB cards and is run by 30 ONI production agents and 40 enrolment sites, according to ONI's Director General.
